Title: Public preview: Vector database add-ons for Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
When it comes to using cognitive search, those at the very beginning of the AI journey are looking for easy to use and inexpensive solutions. Azure Container Apps is providing add-ons for three of the most popular opensource vector database variants, namely Qdrant, Milvus and Weaviate, to enable you to get started quickly and try out innovative use cases before going into production.  

With the native Azure Container Apps integration, and its scale to zero capabilities, these add-ons make it fast, easy, and affordable to try things out.

To learn more, visit: https://aka.ms/aca/addons-vector-dbs
